rationale: Shirley brings hands-on experience building AI productivity tools and consumer applications (with PM experience at Zoom), while Symphony Creative Studio at ByteDance is shipping generative AI video tools for creators and advertisers—a natural intersection of consumer-AI and creator tooling. Their complementary perspectives (researcher + builder on one side, product marketing on the other) could surface useful insights about how AI creative tools land with users and what features actually drive adoption.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet Symphony Creative Studio — you're both working in the consumer-AI and creator-tools space and could share perspectives on what makes generative video tools actually valuable to end users.
